title: Predict the loop's helper output
idea: TOOL. Predict the output of a helper called once per item in a loop.

exercises.explanation: One print per item, 3 items = 3 lines.
2 even True, 3 odd False, 4 even True.

exercises.prompt: A helper that RETURNS can be printed each loop, showing one result per item.
Arrange to print each item's half.
REVIEW (scope): inside each call, the helper's private variable...
options: is fresh and private to that call
carries over from the last item
exercises.explanation: Each call is independent — fresh private notes.

exercises.prompt: The order of printed results matches the order of items in the list.
exercises.explanation: The loop visits items in order, calling the helper in that order.

options: Printing a helper's result each loop shows one answer per item
exercises.explanation: One item in, one result out, repeated.
